item.title: TT-103: Search query syntax
item.brief: Implement TT-103 exactly as in BACKLOG.md. tasktracker.search.search(tasks, query) parses whitespace-separated terms except quoted phrases; all terms AND. Bare words/phrases case-insensitive title match; tag:NAME exact tag case-insensitive; status:open/done status matching. Unknown field:value, unknown status, and unterminated quote raise tasktracker.search.QueryError. Blank query matches all; preserve input order. Add focused tests. Use only the Python standard library. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep existing tests passing. Commit this ticket separately with a ticket-specific commit.

item.title: TT-104: Undo
item.brief: Implement TT-104 exactly as in BACKLOG.md. Add TaskStore.undo() to revert most recent not-yet-undone add/complete/delete in LIFO order across operation kinds. Undo add removes task; undo complete reopens; undo delete restores exact task under same id. Never reuse ids, including after undoing add. NothingToUndo when exhausted. Failed operations must not be recorded. Add focused tests. Use only the Python standard library. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep existing tests passing. Commit this ticket separately with a ticket-specific commit.

item.title: TT-102: RFC 4180 CSV export
item.brief: Implement TT-102 exactly as in BACKLOG.md. tasktracker.export.to_csv(tasks) emits header id,title,tags,status,due and one row per task in given order; tags joined with ;, due ISO date or empty. Quote fields iff they contain comma, double quote, CR, or LF, doubling embedded quotes. End every line, including header, with CRLF. Add focused tests. Use only the Python standard library. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep existing tests passing. Commit this ticket separately with a ticket-specific commit.

item.title: TT-101: Reject impossible due dates
item.brief: Implement TT-101 exactly as in BACKLOG.md. In tasktracker.dates.parse_due(text, today), impossible calendar dates must raise tasktracker.dates.InvalidDate (a ValueError subclass) whose message contains original text. Unsupported forms also raise InvalidDate. Relative +Nd is N days after today and +0d is today; negative or unsigned offsets are invalid. today/tomorrow remain case-insensitive and whitespace tolerant. Add focused tests. Use only the Python standard library. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep existing tests passing. Commit this ticket separately with a ticket-specific commit.
